children: Polish fintech PayPo is considering an initial public offering on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (WSE), two people familiar with the matter told Reuters on Tuesday, adding that no final decisions have been made.

Poland's fintech sector has grown rapidly, supported by a highly developed banking system, strong consumer appetite for innovation and a deep pool of technology talent. PayPo provides buy now, pay later services for online purchases.
"An IPO on the WSE is one of the scenarios being considered by the company," one of the sources said on condition of anonymity. A second source confirmed the plans.
PayPo did not immediately respond to an emailed request for comment.
In 2025, the group reported net profit of 181 million zlotys ($48.7 million). Revenue rose to 416 million zlotys from 285 million zlotys a year earlier.
